articles.title: The Best Space Heaters for a Large Room
articles.description: A 1,500-watt ceiling applies to every plug-in heater, so covering a big room is about how the heat moves, not how much there is. The three that do it, and the claim to ignore.

articles.title: The Quietest Space Heaters You Can Buy
articles.description: Noise is the specification almost nobody publishes. The handful of heaters that state a figure or remove the fan entirely, and how to read the silence they promise.

articles.title: What a Space Heater Actually Costs to Run
articles.description: Every figure you have read rests on an assumption about your electricity rate. Here is the arithmetic with ours stated in the open, and the comparison that actually matters.
